headline: I build your product, from MVP to launch.
intro: I'm Karan, a full-stack developer with 4+ years of shipping production web apps. I work with startups and agencies who need one reliable person to take a product from idea to something real users can sign up for, covering frontend, backend, deployment and, where it helps, AI. I'm available for new projects now.
traveller: I travel, and I still do the building myself.

packages.title: Packages
packages.subtitle: MVP to launch is the main offer. The other two can stand on their own.

items.title: AI integration into an existing product
points: Picking the right model and where it runs
An API or pipeline built into the app
A short report on cost and limits

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.body: €20/hour. One-off projects are quoted from your requirements after a short call, so there are no fixed package prices. You get a written scope and estimate before any work starts.

process.title: How a project runs

steps.title: Call
steps.body: A free 20-minute call about what you're building and what done looks like.

steps.title: Scope
steps.body: A written scope, estimate and timeline, approved before anything starts.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Weekly steps, with a link to click through and a short update each week.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: Code in your repo, deployment in your accounts, docs so your team can run it.

items.question: Are you available now?
items.answer: Yes, I'm taking on new freelance projects.

items.question: How do you charge?
items.answer: €20/hour; projects are quoted after a short call.

items.question: Do you work with agencies?
items.answer: Yes, as a white-label or embedded developer.

items.question: Who owns the code?
items.answer: You do, in your repo and accounts from day one.

items.question: How do we stay in touch?
items.answer: Slack, email or whatever your team uses, with a weekly written update.
